issues.title: Update to Leaflet 1.8
issues.body:
We're currently using Leaflet 1.6 (Nov 19). This was superceded by 1.7.1 in Sep 20, and by 1.8 in April 2022.

We should update Leaflet to Version 1.8 - making note of breaking changes in both 1.7.1 and 1.8.
